div.head: EGu Inscr.
div.ab: Þis syndon þa domas ðe Ælfred cyncg ⁊ Guþrum cyncg gecuron.
Ðis syndon þa domas ðe Ælfred cyncg ⁊ Guðrum cyncg gecuron.
Þis syndon þa domas ðe Ælfred cyncg and Guþrum cyncg gecuron.
Dies sind die Gesetze, die König Aelfred und König Guthrum erkoren (Ferner seine [Aelfreds] und Guthrums und Eadwards [Gesetze] B).
These are the laws which King Alfred and King Guthrum chose (Further, his [Alfred’s] and Guthrum’s and Edward’s [laws] B).
These are the decrees which King Alfred and King Guthrum enacted.
These are the measures agreed upon by King Alfred and King Guthrum.
